heading: Cover letter — SRE / DevOps
body:
I am a Cape Town-based production software engineer with eight years of PHP and Linux. I moved from building client systems into DevOps — owning pipelines, Docker, and AWS for live clients — and I want SRE next: keep services up, automate the path I otherwise walk twice, and make 24/7 ownership not 24/7 firefighting.

At Silicon Overdrive I own production PHP/Laravel on Linux. When a client host died (Indawo), I containerised the app with Docker onto spare CentOS, figured out the networking, and restored the site — first production Docker, not a tutorial. I am first contact when production is wrong: logs, DNS/TLS, MySQL, restore, then the actual cause. I lead SAWIS BI import/export jobs for the wine industry and recover the data path when a job fails. I earned AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional in this role. Earlier at RogerWilco I shipped LAMP applications on Ubuntu and small AWS hosts, including deployments and production issue resolution.

I am honest about the shape of that experience. PHP/Laravel is paid production work, not the headline I want next. My current employer does not run large Kubernetes or SRE programmes, so I do that work myself: a homelab where I self-host, operate a streaming service I treat as SRE, and run Kubernetes (k3s/k3d, two years) and Terraform (two years) on my own infra and on a freelance fleet stack with a friend. I do not claim a Kubernetes cluster at work.

I want a team where production ownership is real. I work SAST (UTC+2) and prefer flexible hours while I finish a BSc in Information Technology at Eduvos alongside a full working week.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome a conversation.
